subject: Archer: credential validation + evidence upload sprint plan
messages:
From: Samantha Ruiz <samantha.ruiz@helixhealth.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: ops@helixhealth.com
Date: 2026-11-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Archer onboarding — manifest + minimal evidence sprint

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for walking us through Archer yesterday. We are ready to move the profile from 'staged' to 'active' but need to complete a short evidence intake so that our procurement and security teams can sign off.

Quick ask: can Redwood provide a manifest (CSV) mapping the attachments you will upload and an S3 presigned upload target (or a vendor-side upload flow) for our team to push logs and a handful of screenshots?

We have a tight procurement window — target signoff by 11/12. If helpful, Ops can allocate a 1-hour upload window and a follow-up review slot.

Thanks,
Samantha
Sr. Vendor Ops | Helix Health
[attachment: helix-evidence-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: Samantha Ruiz <samantha.ruiz@helixhealth.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-05T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Archer onboarding — manifest + minimal evidence sprint

Hi Samantha — great to hear you want to move forward. Outline below to keep things simple and auditable. Please confirm the upload window that works for you and whether you need us to generate presigned URLs or we should request uploads directly in Archer.

Plan (high level)
- We will provide an "upload manifest" CSV that lists expected filenames, CAIQ/SIG mapping tags, and brief provenance notes.
- Preferred flow: Helix pushes artifacts to a temporary S3 bucket we control via presigned PUTs; once validated we will ingest to Archer and attach proofs to your profile.
- If Helix must use the vendor UI instead, we will provide step-by-step guides and an ingestion ticket so we can confirm checksums.

Action items for Helix before upload
1) Scope: which components are in-scope (app-prod logs, infra diagrams, encryption statements, sample syslog).
2) Point of contact for the 1-hour upload window.
3) Any restrictions on storage region or KMS namespace (if you require your own KMS, note it).

I'll attach the manifest draft and a short upload playbook. Ben will coordinate the ingestion and checksum verification; Markus will validate CAIQ mapping.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Vendor Security Lead | Redwood Inference
[attachment: archer_upload_playbook.md (text/markdown)]

From: ben.carter@redwood.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, Samantha Ruiz <samantha.ruiz@helixhealth.com>
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-05T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Archer onboarding — manifest + minimal evidence sprint

Hi all — quick technical notes from ingestion ops:
- We'll spin up a temporary S3 bucket in us-west-2 with server-side encryption (AES256) and 7-day lifecycle then archive to our secure vault. Presigned PUTs will be valid for 6 hours.
- Expected maximum total upload size: 1.2 GB (conservative); chunked PUTs are fine.
- Please use the manifest filename conventions (see draft) so our batch ingest job tags CAIQ fields correctly.

Ben Carter
Security Integrations | Redwood
[attachment: redwood-sample-syslog.txt (text/plain)]

From: Samantha Ruiz <samantha.ruiz@helixhealth.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: ops@helixhealth.com
Date: 2026-11-05T13:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Archer onboarding — manifest + minimal evidence sprint

Thanks Laura / Ben — that workflow works. Confirming scope: app-prod logs (past 7 days), network diagram (png), encryption statement (pdf), and a sample incident response runbook. Ops will do the upload on 2026-11-09 14:00-15:00 PST.

Two quick clarifications:
1) For KMS — we need the artifacts stored in us-west-2 and notes indicating whether Redwood used a customer-managed KMS or Redwood-managed keys (Helix prefers customer-managed if possible).
2) Will the ingested artifacts in Archer be retained in the vendor portal or in our Helix workspace after ingestion? We prefer a copy to remain in our workspace and a checksum + timestamp attached to the Archer profile.

Samantha

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: Samantha Ruiz <samantha.ruiz@helixhealth.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-05T15:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Archer onboarding — manifest + minimal evidence sprint

Samantha — good questions, answers below.

1) KMS and region
- We will provision the temporary S3 bucket in us-west-2 as Ben noted. By default the objects will be encrypted with Redwood-managed CMKs; however, we can configure an upload path that encrypts with your customer-managed key (Helix KMS ARN) if you provide the ARN and IAM principal to allow PutObject with SSE-KMS. Please note cross-account KMS requires a short policy change on your side.

2) Retention and copies
- After ingestion: Redwood will retain the canonical evidence in our secure evidence vault to attach to the Archer profile.
- We will also leave a copy in your Helix workspace (object with postfix ".helix_copy") for 90 days before automatic TTL deletion — this satisfies most procurement requirements for customer possession. Checksums and ingestion timestamps will be written to the Archer profile metadata and we will share a digest CSV after ingestion.

3) Manifest (attached)
- Attached is the upload_manifest.csv (draft). Please ensure filenames match exactly when you upload. Missing or mismatched names will delay ingest.

Next step: Laura to generate presigned PUTs and send to Samantha by EOD. Ben to run a quick test ingest with a small sample file tomorrow morning.

Thanks,
Laura
[attachment: upload_manifest.csv (text/csv)]

From: Samantha Ruiz <samantha.ruiz@helixhealth.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: ops@helixhealth.com
Date: 2026-11-06T16:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Archer onboarding — credential validation + evidence upload sprint plan

Laura / Ben — upload completed and verified on our end. We uploaded the listed files during the 14:00 PST window; checksums matched locally. Two follow-ups:
- Can you confirm the digest CSV and the timestamp that will appear in Archer once you complete ingestion?
- Our security lead asked whether the ingestion workflow preserves original object metadata (Content-Type, original Last-Modified).

If you can confirm those two items we should be set to request procurement signoff tomorrow. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Samantha
